title: The Calamity of Mann
creator: Uther Aix ex Tytalus
comment: Uther Aix was the one surviving magus from the last attempt to found a covenant on the Isle of Mann. He wrote down the little he got a chance to see on the island. The last chapter is, unsurprisingly, an apocalyptic horror story. This last chapter is quite a good read, just not very educational.  Evidently, Uther was a better storyteller than teacher.
